as_told.title: Lynn Buchanan's eyes changed color while remote viewing

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, worked in an Army remote viewing unit at Fort Meade, a group that tried to spy on distant targets using only the mind. He says that around the time of the Gulf War, while he was mentally reaching into the mind of Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein, a woman watching told him, "Your eyes turned brown and your voice deepened." If true, it would mean the link went deeper than just seeing, almost as if he took on part of the target.
